procedure_column: Liu et al. 2024 (JAAS 39) Extraterrestrial samples (Li-borate flux glass) Spot analysis fs-LA-Q-ICP-MS Chinese Academy of Sciences

Procedure Name.cell: Liu et al. (2024) Extraterrestrial Flux Glass fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
Procedure Name.value: Liu et al. (2024) Extraterrestrial Flux Glass fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1

Procedure Author.cell: Liu, Xue, Li, Wang et al.
Procedure Author.value: Liu, Xue, Li, Wang et al.

Laboratory.cell: State Key Laboratory of Lithospheric Evolution and Environmental Coevolution, IGGCAS, Beijing, China
Laboratory.value: State Key Laboratory of Lithospheric Evolution and Environmental Coevolution, IGGCAS, Beijing, China

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: N — the CAS Strategy Priority Research Program and NSFC grant support the study as a whole and are recorded under Funding Source for Analysis

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Liu et al. (2024) JAAS 39, 2728; Pettke et al. (2012) for LOD
Procedure Reference(s).value: Liu et al. (2024) JAAS 39, 2728; Pettke et al. (2012) for LOD

Target Material.cell: Li-borate flux fusion glass (extraterrestrial sample preparation)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Aliquot (fused Li-borate glass disc) > Spot — "Nine spot analyses ... were arranged in a grid pattern to cover the entire glass" (p.5), and compositions are reported as the mean of those spots, "fs-LA-ICP-MS (n = 9 spots)" (Table 2, p.8)

Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio.cell: Li₂B₄O₇ flux; sample:flux = 1:35 (10 mg sample + 350 mg flux)
Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio.value: Li₂B₄O₇ flux; sample:flux = 1:35 (10 mg sample + 350 mg flux)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Li2B4O7 flux (350.0 ± 0.3 mg) and powdered sample (10.00 ± 0.03 mg) weighed into a small Pt–Au crucible, mixed with a glass rod, NH4Br solution added as a releasing agent, and fused into a mini glass disk on an M4 automatic fluxer; the disk measured for major elements by WD-XRF, then its surface cleaned with ethanol before fs-LA-ICP-MS (§2.3)
Sample Preparation Method.value: Li2B4O7 flux (350.0 ± 0.3 mg) and powdered sample (10.00 ± 0.03 mg) weighed into a small Pt–Au crucible, mixed with a glass rod, NH4Br solution added as a releasing agent, and fused into a mini glass disk on an M4 automatic fluxer; the disk measured for major elements by WD-XRF, then its surface cleaned with ethanol before fs-LA-ICP-MS (§2.3)

Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.cell: Surface cleaning with ethanol before analysis
Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.value: Surface cleaning with ethanol before analysis

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Coverage — "Nine spot analyses ... were arranged in a grid pattern to cover the entire glass" (p.5), the grid being the test of whether the fused disc is homogeneous

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: N — the fused glass discs are prepared for XRF and then ablated directly; no imaging or screening step is described before the LA-ICP-MS spots, whose grid is laid out to cover the whole disc (p.5)

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Shanghai Chemlab GenesisGEO (high-repetition-rate fs laser, 343 nm)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Shanghai Chemlab GenesisGEO (high-repetition-rate fs laser, 343 nm)

ICP-MS Type.cell: N — ICP-MS type not stated; Agilent 8900 model named but "quadrupole" or "ICP-MS/MS" not used in paper

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: all: 100 µm — '100 µm-diameter ablating spots' (§2.2); Table 1 gives 'Ablation spot size 100 × 100 µm'

Laser Pulse Duration.cell: N — 'femtosecond'; the laser's details are in Table S1, not in the archived PDF

Ablation Duration per Spot.cell: 45 s ablation (after 25 s gas blank; 25 s washout between analyses)
Ablation Duration per Spot.value: 45 s ablation (after 25 s gas blank; 25 s washout between analyses)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He: chamber gas 0.7 L/min; cup gas 0.1 L/min — Table 1
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He: chamber gas 0.7 L/min; cup gas 0.1 L/min

ICP Tuning.cell: Gas flows optimised by spot ablation of NIST SRM 612 'to obtain maximum signal intensities while maintaining ThO/Th at <0.3% and U/Th at 0.95–1.05' (§2.2); sampling depth 8 mm (Table 1)
ICP Tuning.value: Gas flows optimised by spot ablation of NIST SRM 612 'to obtain maximum signal intensities while maintaining ThO/Th at <0.3% and U/Th at 0.95–1.05' (§2.2); sampling depth 8 mm (Table 1)

Analysis Sequence.cell: Per spot: 25 s gas blank, 45 s ablation, 25 s washout between analyses (§2.2); the order of standards and unknowns is not described
Analysis Sequence.value: Per spot: 25 s gas blank, 45 s ablation, 25 s washout between analyses (§2.2); the order of standards and unknowns is not described

Target Species.cell: Sc, V, Cr, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ga, Rb, Sr, Y, Zr, Nb, Ba, La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu, Hf, Ta, Th, U — the 32 trace elements of Table 2 and §3.1

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: N — the isotopes measured are not stated in the paper

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Sc, V, Cr, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ga, Rb, Sr, Y, Zr, Nb, Ba, La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu, Hf, Ta, Th, U — concentrations reported as 'Mean' with a '95% CI' per sample (Table 2), which gives no unit; the LODs are in µg g⁻¹ (§3.2). Relative standard deviations are the precision measure (§3.5)

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: all: 30 ms/10 ms — Table 1 'Dwell time per isotope'; which isotopes take which is not stated

Background Count Time.cell: 25 s gas blank before each ablation
Background Count Time.value: 25 s gas blank before each ablation

Number of Replicates.cell: 9 spots per glass disk — 'Nine spot analyses (spot size = 100 µm) were arranged in a grid pattern to cover the entire glass' (§3.1); Table 2 'n = 9 spots'

Internal Standard Approach.cell: all: two internal standard elements, chosen per target element — Si for Co, Ni, Cu and Zn, and Al for the others, after comparing Si, Ca and Al on GSR-3 (§3.3); the disks were 'initially measured for major elements by WD-XRF' (§2.3)

value.value: two internal standard elements, chosen per target element

Internal Standard Element.cell: all: Si (for Co, Ni, Cu, Zn), Al (for the other trace elements) — §3.3

value.value: Si (for Co, Ni, Cu, Zn), Al (for the other trace elements)

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: N — the paper states that fs lasers 'are considered stoichiometric erosion processes without any element or isotope fractionation effects' (§3.4); no correction is described

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: 25 s gas blank before each ablation; flux procedure-blank contributions deducted for V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta and U — 'after measuring a gas blank for 25 s' (§2.2); 'All results of the eight pollution elements above have deducted the flux blank contributions' (§3.2)
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: 25 s gas blank before each ablation; flux procedure-blank contributions deducted for V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta and U

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: N — Table 1 gives 'Detector mode: Dual'; a cross-calibration is not described

Interfering Species.cell: N — the flux-blank elements (V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U) are a blank contribution, recorded under Blank / Background Correction Method

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — each reported value is the mean of a stated count, "fs-LA-ICP-MS (n = 9 spots)" against "SN-ICP-MS (n = 5)" (Table 2, p.8), with a 95% confidence interval. No acceptance or rejection rule, and no acquired-versus-included count, is stated

Combination Method.cell: all: mean of n = 9 spots per sample — Table 2: 'Mean' with '95% CI', 'fs-LA-ICP-MS (n = 9 spots)'

value.value: mean of n = 9 spots per sample

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [all: NIST SRM 612 and NIST SRM 614] — non-matrix-matched external standards; matrix-matched BHVO-2 borate glass was tested and gave poorer results (§3.4)

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: AC-E, GSR-1, JB-1b, GSR-3, AGV-2, W-2A — six silicate rock GRMs prepared as lithium borate glasses and 'analyzed to evaluate the performance of the proposed method' (§2.1); reference values from GeoReM (§3.5). The meteorites NWA13190 and NWA14526 are samples, compared with solution ICP-MS

Detection Limit.cell: all: 0.005–23.5 µg g⁻¹ — LODs of 32 elements in lithium borate glass BHVO-2 (Table S2); 0.007–0.45 µg g⁻¹ calculated for NIST 610 (§3.2)

Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method.cell: V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U: blank value + 10SD (IUPAC Gold Book); other: 3.3 × LOD — §3.2

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: AC-E, GSR-1, JB-1b, GSR-3, AGV-2, W-2A [all: RSD better than 10% for most elements] — §3.5, Fig. 5b; higher RSDs for Zn in GSR-1, Tm, Yb and Lu in GSR-3, Lu in AGV-2, and Ta and U in W-2A

value.value: RSD better than 10% for most elements

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: AC-E, GSR-1, JB-1b, GSR-3, AGV-2, W-2A [all: within 10% of the GeoReM reference values for most trace elements] — §3.5, Fig. 5a; discrepancies >15% for Co in AGV-2, JB-1b and W-2A, Ni in JB-1b, Cu in AGV-2 and JB-1b, Zn and Hf in GSR-1

value.value: within 10% of the GeoReM reference values for most trace elements
